name: Swarm of Carrion Bell Choirs

Traits.name: Fear Aura
Traits.text: The swarm emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 17, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.

Traits.name: Swarm
Traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The swarm makes two Bells attacks.

Actions.name: Bells
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, or 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Thunder damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

Actions.name: Last-Warmth Knell (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation. *Failure:* 65 (10d12) Necrotic damage. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.clause: The swarm rings a single, sustained knell that only the dying can hear, drawing the last warmth from their bodies. Each

lore: Hung in a mass grave by a forgotten plague-cart parish, the bells were taken by the dead and now seek the dying, for only a final toll can complete what they are.

generation.userConcept: a swarm of funeral bells that ring themselves over the dying

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
monsterDescription: a swarm of funeral bells that ring themselves over the dying
